Name: DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistance
Description: Controls a distance threshold used when changing the level of detail for CSG (constructive solid geometry) objects. Exact units and valid limits are not documented publicly.
Warning: Experimental geometry tuning. May worsen pop-in or rendering.

Name: DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistanceL12
Description: Adjusts a CSG level-of-detail transition distance between detail levels 1 and 2. Units and supported ranges are undocumented.
Warning: Changing LOD distances may affect both appearance and performance.

Name: DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistanceL23
Description: Adjusts a CSG level-of-detail transition distance between detail levels 2 and 3. Exact behaviour can change by client version.
Warning: Experimental. Values outside normal ranges can cause rendering issues.

Name: DFIntCSGLevelOfDetailSwitchingDistanceL34
Description: Adjusts a CSG level-of-detail transition distance between detail levels 3 and 4. The precise range and units are not publicly documented.

Name: FFlagHandleAltEnterFullscreenManually
Description: Controls manual handling of Alt+Enter for fullscreen switching. Historically used by third-party bootstrapper fullscreen presets.
Warning: Fullscreen behaviour can depend on the graphics backend and Roblox version.

Name: DFFlagTextureQualityOverrideEnabled
Description: Enables Roblox's texture-quality override mechanism, which works in conjunction with DFIntTextureQualityOverride.
Warning: Use with the texture quality value flag; results may vary by experience.

Name: DFIntTextureQualityOverride
Description: Requests an internal texture-quality override. The interpretation of numeric values is internal and can change.
Warning: Lower or higher values are not guaranteed to improve performance or visuals.

Name: FIntDebugForceMSAASamples
Description: Requests a multisample anti-aliasing (MSAA) sample count for rendering. Hardware/backend support can constrain the actual effect.
Warning: Higher sample counts can raise GPU load; unsupported values may be ignored.

Name: DFFlagDisableDPIScale
Description: Controls whether Roblox disables its DPI-based rendering scale. May preserve sharpness at Windows scaling settings above 100%.
Warning: May increase GPU requirements or affect UI scaling.

Name: FFlagDebugGraphicsPreferD3D11
Description: Requests Direct3D 11 as the preferred graphics backend when the client and hardware support it.
Warning: Do not enable multiple conflicting graphics-backend preferences together.

Name: FFlagDebugSkyGray
Description: A debug-related sky visual flag. It may change sky rendering; its exact effect is not formally documented.
Warning: Can affect the intended appearance of experiences.

Name: DFFlagDebugPauseVoxelizer
Description: An internal debugging switch associated with the voxelizer/rendering system. Its actual impact is undocumented.
Warning: Not recommended unless you know exactly why you're testing it.

Name: DFIntDebugFRMQualityLevelOverride
Description: Overrides an internal FRM rendering-quality setting. Exact accepted values and their meanings are undocumented.
Warning: Experimental quality override; may produce unpredictable visuals.

Name: FIntFRMMaxGrassDistance
Description: An internal setting associated with the maximum distance used for grass rendering.
Warning: Units and reasonable values are not publicly documented.

Name: FIntFRMMinGrassDistance
Description: An internal setting associated with the minimum distance used for grass rendering.
Warning: Grass visibility can depend on other quality settings.

Name: FFlagDebugGraphicsPreferVulkan
Description: Requests Vulkan as the preferred graphics backend where it is supported.
Warning: Can be incompatible with some GPU/driver combinations; avoid conflicting backend preferences.

Name: FFlagDebugGraphicsPreferOpenGL
Description: Requests OpenGL as the preferred graphics backend when available.
Warning: Support varies across current Roblox releases and systems.

Name: FIntGrassMovementReducedMotionFactor
Description: An internal factor associated with reduced grass movement. The range and effective values have not been publicly specified.
Warning: Avoid assuming any particular numeric value is the official accessibility preset.
